diagnosis.summary: Connection refused before request transmission during Telegram action execution, failing prior to any request dispatch across all attempts.
alternate_explanations: Provider infrastructure outage or connectivity block preventing TCP/TLS establishment before transmission.

proposal.summary: Escalate the connection refusal error before transmission to provider/engineering investigation as a connection/infrastructure fault.
reasons: Observed delivery failure occurred prior to request transmission due to connection refusal.
Connection refusal, transport recovery, and provider infrastructure failures belong to engineering and provider investigation.
preconditions: Verify network connectivity and provider status out-of-band.
